name: bing-webmaster-pp-mcp
description: Every Bing Webmaster API endpoint, plus the SEO intelligence no other Bing tool ships: period-over-period deltas, ranking drift, quota-aware bulk submission, and Bing-vs-Google reconciliation — all backed by a local SQLite store.

bing_webmaster_api_key.title: BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY
bing_webmaster_api_key.description: Sets BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY for the Bing Webmaster Tools MCP server. Get a credential from https://www.bing.com/webmasters.

bing_webmaster_base_url.title: BING_WEBMASTER_BASE_URL
bing_webmaster_base_url.description: Optional. Sets BING_WEBMASTER_BASE_URL for the Bing Webmaster Tools MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

bing_webmaster_user_agent.title: BING_WEBMASTER_USER_AGENT
bing_webmaster_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets BING_WEBMASTER_USER_AGENT for the Bing Webmaster Tools MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
